free_tier.stated: Live English page, verbatim: 'MiraclePlus Compute is open to universities, research institutes, enterprises, startups, and independent researchers globally. Your physical location or business registration does not affect eligibility. While our infrastructure is based in Haidian, Beijing, we fully support remote access for international teams, and have supported 60+ teams worldwide.' Quota line, verbatim: 'Up to 1 million RMB in compute Quota (equivalent to 8x H800 cards for 15 months).' Mechanism, verbatim: 'Credits will be allocated based on a comprehensive assessment of each project. Once accepted, credits are issued on a dedicated platform for immediate use.' Chinese counterpart, verbatim: 'Qiji compute is open to universities, research institutes, large enterprises, startups and independent individual researchers. Wherever you are, and whether or not the business is in China, you may apply if you meet the conditions. The compute is deployed in Haidian, Beijing, but international teams are supported for remote use.'

chaining: Nothing chains usefully here. One award of CNY 1,000,000 in platform credits replaces a stack of spot instances and notebook quotas outright. The break is that the credits spend only on the provider's own dedicated platform at the provider's own rate card, so the award converts to GPU-hours at their price and not at a market price.

notes: SETTLED: the two batch-1 readings did not actually conflict. The Chinese page and the English page both name individual freelancers and independent researchers globally, and both deny that physical location or business registration affects eligibility. No Chinese entity, national ID or in-country presence is required by the page. What batch 1 missed is that this is not a quota with a self-service signup: the mechanism is a written application reviewed like an accelerator investment, and the operator's municipal sponsor publishes the bar, recorded in the sibling finding in this file. CORRECTION 1: batch 1 recorded the apply URL as apply.miracleplus.com/high_quality_content. That URL is the site-wide header link labelled Featured Content, present on every page; the compute page's three buttons carry data-apply-url https://apply.miracleplus.com/?p=gpu, which redirects to sign-in and then to the Qiji accelerator application. CORRECTION 2: batch 1 treated the Haidian news page's freelancer line as the eligibility bar. The binding document is the district government's own scheme guideline, which lists six criteria for the individual. CORRECTION 3: see the separate finding on the site counter, which batch 1 read as evidence of scale. Open: the median award is unpublished; the page states only a maximum, and nothing establishes how far a typical award falls below it.
